reviews.title: Great game but has some more potential
reviews.text: I have been playing this game for months now, I love this game and play it everyday. Except there is TOO MANY ADS! Before I read the other reviews I thought I needed a new battery because after just 25-30 minutes of playing this game drained half my battery. And the reason I was talking about the reviews was because they said the ads were the problem because they had the exact same issue. All I want to say is that this game needs to lower the amount of repetitive, annoying, and battery draining ads.
